name: Cheesy Southwestern Ground Turkey Skillet
ingredients_verbatim: 1 cup chopped bell peppers (green peppers have the fewest carbs)
why: Verified from source page: 434 cal / 9g carbs / 35g protein / 29g fat per serving (4 servings) - dead-center of the 400-650 cal band and well under the 35g carb ceiling at only 9g, so it has ample headroom against carb-recompute drift. Structurally low-carb: ground turkey + bell peppers + onion + melted cheddar + black olives with no rice, pasta, potato, beans, OR cauliflower-rice base. Pure stovetop skillet, no bake. Scales cleanly to 14 servings by weigh-and-divide. Every ingredient maps to an existing board commodity (Ground Turkey, Bell Pepper, Onions, Cheddar, Black Olives, Olive Oil) - fully priceable, zero unmapped. CONFIDENCE: nutrition HIGH (read directly from the recipe card). DEDUP CAVEAT: shares the Southwestern/taco spice family with two pool items (southwest-ground-turkey-cauliflower-rice-skillet and low-carb-turkey-taco-skillet), but the composition is distinct - this is a cheddar-and-olive cheesy skillet with no grain/cauli base, not a cauliflower-rice bowl or a salsa taco skillet. Flagging for the adjudicator to rule on family overlap.
